text:
### Scope  
Applies to:
- All customer account openings (retail, joint accounts)
- All new customer relationships
- Periodic re-verification (per [[business_ontology]] KYC Verification entity)
- All staff involved in customer onboarding  
Does not apply to:
- Existing customers (unless triggered by risk reassessment)
- Regulatory authorities
- Internal bank accounts

raw_entities.name: Customer Account Opening and KYC Verification Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the scope and application of customer account opening procedures and Know Your Customer verification requirements. Establishes mandatory KYC processes for retail and joint account openings, new customer relationships, and periodic re-verification activities. Defines staff responsibilities in customer onboarding and specifies exclusions for existing customers, regulatory authorities, and internal bank accounts.
context: Applies to: All customer account openings (retail, joint accounts)
All new customer relationships
Periodic re-verification (per [[business_ontology]] KYC Verification entity)
All staff involved in customer onboarding

raw_entities.name: Mandatory KYC Verification at Account Opening
raw_entities.description: Requires KYC verification to be performed for all retail and joint account openings and new customer relationships. This is a core compliance obligation that must be completed before account activation.
context: Applies to: All customer account openings (retail, joint accounts)
All new customer relationships

raw_entities.name: Periodic KYC Re-verification Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates periodic re-verification of customer KYC information at defined intervals as specified in the business ontology KYC Verification entity. This ensures ongoing compliance and risk management for existing customer relationships.
context: Periodic re-verification (per [[business_ontology]] KYC Verification entity)

raw_entities.name: Staff Responsibility for Customer Onboarding
raw_entities.description: Establishes that all staff involved in customer onboarding are subject to and responsible for implementing the KYC verification requirements defined in this policy.
context: All staff involved in customer onboarding

raw_entities.name: Exclusion of Existing Customers from Routine KYC
raw_entities.description: Specifies that existing customers are not subject to routine KYC verification unless a risk reassessment is triggered. This provision establishes the boundary between new customer onboarding and ongoing customer management.
context: Does not apply to: Existing customers (unless triggered by risk reassessment)

raw_entities.name: Exclusion of Regulatory Authorities from KYC Requirements
raw_entities.description: Exempts regulatory authorities from KYC verification requirements under this policy.
context: Does not apply to: Regulatory authorities

raw_entities.name: Exclusion of Internal Bank Accounts from KYC Requirements
raw_entities.description: Exempts internal bank accounts from KYC verification requirements under this policy.
context: Does not apply to: Internal bank accounts

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification
raw_entities.description: The Know Your Customer verification process required at account opening and periodically thereafter. Applies to all retail and joint account openings and new customer relationships as a mandatory compliance control.
context: All customer account openings (retail, joint accounts)
All new customer relationships
Periodic re-verification (per [[business_ontology]] KYC Verification entity)

raw_entities.name: Retail Account
raw_entities.description: A retail customer account subject to KYC verification requirements at opening and periodic re-verification as defined in this policy.
context: All customer account openings (retail, joint accounts)

raw_entities.name: Joint Account
raw_entities.description: A joint account held by multiple customers subject to KYC verification requirements at opening and periodic re-verification as defined in this policy.
context: All customer account openings (retail, joint accounts)

raw_entities.name: New Customer
raw_entities.description: A customer entering into a new relationship with the bank and opening an account. Subject to mandatory KYC verification before account activation.
context: All new customer relationships
All customer account openings (retail, joint accounts)

raw_entities.name: Existing Customer
raw_entities.description: A customer with an established relationship with the bank. Exempt from routine KYC verification unless a risk reassessment is triggered.
context: Does not apply to: Existing customers (unless triggered by risk reassessment)

raw_entities.name: Customer Onboarding Staff
raw_entities.description: All staff members involved in the customer account opening and onboarding process. Responsible for implementing and executing KYC verification requirements as defined in this policy.
context: All staff involved in customer onboarding
